messages.content: What is the current time in New York City?

function.name: weather_forecast_get
function.description: Retrieve the current weather forecast for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location you want to retrieve the weather for.

hour.description: The hour of the day in 24-hour format (optional). If not provided, the current hour will be used. Default: 24

message.content:
I don’t have access to live clocks, so I can’t give you an exact “now” value.  
New York City is on Eastern Time:

| Daylight Saving | Standard |
|-----------------|----------|
| DST (summer)    | UTC‑04   |
| STD (winter)    | UTC‑05   |

If it’s currently daylight‑saving time, subtract four hours from Coordinated Universal Time (UTC); otherwise subtract five hours. You can get the precise moment by looking at your phone, computer, or a trusted online world‑clock service.

The user asks "current time" but we have no tool for time; only weather. We can approximate using timezone offset or use external knowledge. But as per policy, cannot provide inaccurate info.
